values.note: Reservations need at least 2 nights until DEC's season opens (May 8 in 2026, when its first campgrounds open): 'When the first campground opens for the season, the reservation minimums at all facilities will become 1 night until closing.' DEC's 2026 campground summary. ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead; same-day reservations until 5 pm on the day of arrival; 'Walk-ins will not be permitted' at DEC campgrounds.

values.note: DEC's page says 37 tent and trailer sites; ReserveAmerica's description says 41 and its list shows 33 campsites (Launt Pond sites 001-019 and 020-025, Spruce Grove horse-area sites 026-037) plus 2 group camps. Listed lengths 20-40 ft; Launt Pond has three 40-ft back-ins, and Spruce Grove has pull-throughs to 40 ft. Some sites close while DEC's Campsite Restoration Project works on them.

sites.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/bear-spring-mountain-campground-and-day-use-area (Amenities: '37 tent and trailer sites'; Campsite Restoration Project 'the chosen sites will be closed') + https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/bear-spring-mountain/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=13 ('The campground offers 41 tent and trailer sites'; 'Campsite (33)') + ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 13 (all pages; 30 of 33 campsites parsed) ('40 Back-In' x3 in Sites 001-019, '40 Pull-Through' in Spruce Grove), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Hot showers and flush toilets at the Launt Pond Area; pit toilets at Spruce Grove.

facilities.source: https://dec.ny.gov/places/bear-spring-mountain-campground-and-day-use-area ('flush toilets and hot showers at Launt Pond Area'; Spruce Grove Area 'pit toilets'; 'trailer dump station'), read 2026-10-21

note: DEC (Catskill Forest Preserve), Launt Pond near Walton (not Bear Mountain State Park). Horse campers use the separate Spruce Grove area (24 tie stalls); a general campground, not equestrian-only. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on DEC's page and ReserveAmerica: $18 + $5 non-resident, phone, reservable on RA with the 9-month window; added same-day until 5 pm and no walk-ins (fcfs never), no electric (catalog), 37 tent/trailer sites (DEC; RA says 41 and lists 33) to 40 ft, showers, flush toilets, Spruce Grove pit toilets, dump. Season left as read 2026-10-20 (2027 opens May 14); DEC's page shows 2026 May 15 - Sep 7. Note trimmed: the MINIMUM STAY line repeats booking.min_stay/booking.note and the site count/hookups/RA mentions repeat fields. Not stated: water/sewer at sites (left derived false), max stay (inherited).
